rows.grounds: adverbial accusative indicating frequency at three occasions
copulative compound denoting the ritual acts to be performed
conjunction connecting or adding the prescribed action
compound describing the bali-homa as joined with fifty musical instruments

items.question: At what frequency and with what musical accompaniment must the offering and oblation be performed?
premises: The ritual action prescribed is the offering and oblation.
This offering and oblation is to be performed at three times.
The performance must be accompanied by fifty musical instruments.
items.inference: The offering and oblation should be carried out three times together with accompaniment by fifty instruments.
uncertainties: The exact three times intended may depend on the preceding context of the three junctures.
items.plain_english: One should perform the offering and oblation three times, accompanied by fifty musical instruments.
